brief:
Israeli forces have installed two mobile homes in the village of Beita, south of Nablus in the occupied West Bank, according to Shehab Wire. The structures were positioned in the Palestinian community as part of what Israeli authorities describe as military infrastructure development in the area.

Beita has been a flashpoint for Israeli military activity and settlement expansion. The village has experienced repeated incursions by Israeli forces and clashes with Palestinian residents over land disputes and the establishment of nearby outposts. The installation of the mobile homes represents a continued Israeli military presence in communities across the southern Nablus region, where similar structures have been deployed at various sites in recent years.
